tasks.name: Research ADHD Needs and Existing Solutions
tasks.description: Conduct thorough research on ADHD-specific productivity challenges, interview potential users, and analyze existing apps to identify gaps and opportunities

tasks.name: Define Core Features and Value Proposition
tasks.description: Establish the app's unique value, key features (e.g., task management, focus timers, reminders), and target user persona

tasks.name: Create Wireframes and User Flows
tasks.description: Design low-fidelity wireframes and user flow diagrams to visualize the app structure and navigation

tasks.name: Develop High-Fidelity UI Design
tasks.description: Create polished visual designs with ADHD-friendly principles (minimal distractions, clear hierarchy, intuitive interactions)

tasks.name: Create Interactive Prototype
tasks.description: Build a clickable prototype to test usability and gather feedback from potential users

tasks.name: Plan Development Approach
tasks.description: Research technical requirements, decide on development platform (native vs cross-platform), and outline development roadmap
